task.instruction: Recommend an intervention for failed invoice retries when both message clarity and retry scheduling contribute to recovery.
task.deliverable: A scoped recommendation, billing-protection invariant, and evidence citations.

evidence.content: A synthetic sample attributes 58% of failures to expired payment details and 27% to temporary issuer rejection.
A synthetic billing invariant binds every retry to the original order transaction, requiring the system to prevent a second charge regardless of the chosen recovery pattern.
Clearer messages recover expired-detail cases; spaced retries recover temporary rejections but increase notification volume.

A.content: Prefer a bounded intervention at the immediate decision point when wider changes are not required by the evidence.

B.content: Prefer an intervention that accounts for connected incentives and downstream effects when the evidence shows they matter.

irrelevant.content: Keep the artifact title concise enough to fit on one line.
